content.text:
Not by default. December 22nd falls inside the year-end code freeze, which runs Dec 15 to Jan 5 while Finance runs the annual close.

Per the project's release notes, no production release may go out in that window, and that includes hotfixes. The one exception is if a lead in #fin-eng signs off in the channel first.

Since Finance is the one asking for the fix, you may be able to get that sign-off quickly. Ask in #fin-eng and get the approval written down in the channel before you tag.

- **Day of week:** Dec 22, 2026 is a Tuesday, so the "no Fridays after 14:00 UTC" rule doesn't apply.
- **Tag:** if approved, push `vYYYY.MM.N` (for example `v2026.12.1`). CI builds and publishes, so don't publish by hand.
- **Approval step:** staging is promoted automatically. Production needs a manual approval in the CI UI from someone on the billing team, so line that person up ahead of time.
- **Checklist:** finish the release checklist in the PR template before tagging. Any migrations have to ship in the same release as the code that needs them.

The alternative is to release before Dec 15, which needs no exception. That may be easier if the fix can be ready by then.
